name: Arise Notes: Notes Super App
subtitle: AI note taker & transcripts
promo: Record a meeting, class or appointment and get a clean transcript, a summary and the action items, ready to share.
description:
Arise Notes listens so you don't have to scribble. Record a meeting, a class, a doctor's visit or a quick idea, and get back a transcript, a summary and what to do next.

RECORD OR UPLOAD
- Record right in the app, or upload audio you already have
- Quick voice memos for ideas on the go
- Mark important moments while you record

WHAT YOU GET
- A full transcript, with who said what
- A summary with key points, decisions and questions
- Action items with who and when
- Dates and meetings to add to your calendar

MADE FOR YOUR KIND OF NOTE
- Templates for meetings, lectures, doctor visits, interviews, parent-teacher meetings and IEP meetings
- Flashcards and quizzes from a lecture
- Translations and parent-friendly versions

FIND AND SHARE
- Ask your notes a question and get an answer from what was said
- Folders and tags
- Share a note with a link, or export it

Recordings are used only to make your note. You choose whether to keep the audio after it's transcribed.

The free plan includes 60 minutes of AI notes a month. Notes Plus is part of Arise All Access, a monthly subscription you can buy in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews each month unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms: https://arisetodo.com/terms/
Privacy: https://arisetodo.com/privacy/
reviewNotes: Sign in with the account above (tap Sign in, then use the username and password). It's a sample account with Arise All Access switched on and three sample notes. Open a note to see its transcript; tap Write the summary to see the AI summary. Recording asks for the microphone only when you tap Record. Audio is sent to our speech-to-text and AI providers to make the transcript and summary, as the privacy policy says. To test buying, Arise All Access is the in-app subscription on the plan screen in Settings.
